title: Three Amigos!
about: Three silent film stars mistake a real call for help from a Mexican village for a paid show.
cue: Serve the mains when El Guapo asks if he has a plethora of piñatas.

Santa Poco CantinaThree Amigos!Tacos. Heaps of tacos.Every recipe serves 4.
    StartersMainsSweetsDrinks
    StartersSanta Poco street cornCharred corn with lime mayo, crumbled feta, chilli powder and corianderHow to make it4 corn cobs4 tbsp mayonnaise2 limes100g feta1 tsp chilli powder1 bunch corianderGrill the corn on a hot barbecue or grill pan, turning, until charred in spots.Mix the mayonnaise with the lime juice and crumble the feta.Brush the cobs with the mayonnaise, roll in feta and dust with chilli powder and chopped coriander.Singing bush salsaCharred tomatillo and green chilli salsa with warm corn chipsHow to make it400g tomatillos2 green chillies1/2 brown onion1 garlic clove1 bunch coriander1 lime300g corn chipsChar the tomatillos and chillies under a hot grill until blistered.Blitz with the onion, garlic, coriander and lime juice until chunky. Season to taste.Serve with warm corn chips.MainsEl Guapo's birthday tacosAchiote pork in corn tortillasHow to make it1.2kg pork shoulder50g achiote paste2 oranges3 garlic cloves1 red onion1 lime16 corn tortillas1 jar habanero salsaRub the pork with the achiote paste, orange juice and crushed garlic and marinate in the fridge overnight, or at least an hour if short on time.Wrap the pork tightly in foil and roast at 160°C until falling apart.Slice the red onion thin and quick-pickle in lime juice with a pinch of salt.Shred the pork in its juices and warm the tortillas.Serve in tortillas with the pickled onion and habanero salsa.Hollywood red chilli chicken enchiladasRed chilli chicken enchiladas, the day Flugelman fired themHow to make itAs written, serves 4Poached chicken and cheese rolled in corn tortillas, smothered in a smoky red chilli sauce and more cheese, baked bubbling, with sour cream and coriander.Poach 800g chicken thighs in salted water for 20 minutes and shred.Soften a diced onion and 2 garlic cloves, add 2 tsp chilli powder, 1 tsp cumin, 1 chipotle in adobo, 700g passata and 200ml stock and simmer 15 minutes.Mix the chicken with a little sauce and 100g cheese.Roll in 12 corn tortillas, lay in a dish, cover with sauce and 150g cheese and bake at 190°C for 20 minutes.Top with sour cream and coriander.SweetsA plethora of churrosFried cinnamon sugar churros with dulce de leche for dippingHow to make it250ml water60g butter150g plain flour2 eggs2 L vegetable oil100g caster sugar2 tsp ground cinnamon1 jar dulce de lecheBoil the water and butter, tip in the flour and beat to a smooth ball. Cool slightly, then beat in the eggs.Pipe the dough with a star nozzle into 180°C oil and fry until golden, turning once.Toss in the sugar and cinnamon while hot.Serve with dulce de leche for dipping and a candle in the pile.DrinksEl Guapo's margaritasTequila, orange liqueur, lime, salt rim. "Is it fattening?"How to make it180ml tequila80ml orange liqueur4 limes1 box sea salt flakes1 bag iceJuice the limes and rim four glasses with a lime wedge and salt.Shake the tequila, orange liqueur and lime juice with ice in batches, one drink at a time.Strain into the glasses over fresh ice.
